annotations.title: The hiring market right now: open and new roles, who is adding and cutting...

description: Job Spotter. The hiring market right now: open and new roles, who is adding and cutting, pay, AI roles, layoffs. For "how's the job market?", "is tech hiring picking up?", "is it a good time to look for sales jobs in the UK?". From Job Spotter's own index of employers' career pages: open roles, roles added in the last 7 days against the week before, roles taken down, employers adding and cutting back (and which), median advertised pay, the share of AI and machine learning roles, a split by job area and country, what job seekers search for most and find least (anonymous, 10 or more searches), and US layoff notices under the WARN Act with the employers that are hiring and filing layoffs at the same time. Use it as fresh evidence when advising on where to look; it is a large sample, not a count of every job. A ready-to-read summary is in `say`.

country.description: Optional country by name or two-letter code, for example United Kingdom, US or DE. Leave out for worldwide.

function.description: Optional job area: software, data (data and AI), design, product, sales, finance, marketing, customer, healthcare, education, people, legal, operations, hardware, service or management. A job word such as "nurse" works too.

where.description: Optional town or city (for example London or Austin), or remote.
